name: html-resume
description: Create or redesign recruiter-friendly HTML resumes with validated A4 PDF output.

interface.shortDescription: Recruiter-ready HTML resumes and A4 PDFs
interface.longDescription: Create or redesign resumes, CVs, executive profiles, professional biographies, and portfolio summaries with factual content rewriting, restrained editorial hierarchy, exact A4 layout, and rendered PDF validation.
defaultPrompt: Use html-resume to rewrite my career information into a recruiter-friendly HTML resume without inventing facts.
Use html-resume to create an A4 HTML resume, export it to PDF, and validate every rendered page.
